description: Huawei 4G CPE 5: 4×1G. Wi-Fi 6, 2.4 GHz 574M, 5 GHz 2.4G. The 150 Mbps cellular uplink is a radio, not a socket - it resolves to the cellular cage and cannot be cabled. RJ45 ports are auto-adaptive, so which one is WAN is a configuration choice rather than a hardware one. Requested in #149; figures from https://consumer.huawei.com/en/routers/4g-cpe-5/specs/
label: HUAWEI 4G CPE 5
